method.independentReviewer: Runtime author independently reviewed the Web partition; not the ProjectDialog/Workspace UI implementation author.
method.frozenIntegrity: All 229 current file SHA-256 values equal their round3 manifest entries at report generation. The global digest stays bound to the original 1975-file snapshot, not a silently rebound workspace.
method.sourceReview: Fresh whole-partition inventory and semantic boundary inspection of every production module. Full reads for the application orchestration, ProjectDialog, root controls, model selection, public message/summary/footer, shared resource and conversation hooks, all library modules, and selected other components. Per-file depth above distinguishes full reads from selected semantic boundaries. No old audit conclusions used as proof.
method.testsReview: Fresh structural coverage inspection of every Web test file; full assertion reads for project-create, project-handoff, execution-mode, shared-model-directory and turn-footer; selected modal and organization bodies. Test helpers and preview fixture read in full. Existing author evidence is separately attributed.

currentReproduction.meaning: Two focused reproductions assert the current faulty comparison and actual wrong UI request. Passing here proves the defect, not a repair.
currentReproduction.isolation: Actual sameRoot, NativeProjects and Api imported; jsdom, fresh fake IndexedDB and fetch stub only. No worker, real project, credentials, network request or deployment.

authorEvidenceChecked.attribution: Existing UI author run: 64 tests in 3 files. JSON result inspected, not rerun by this reviewer. Reported Web tsc/build exit 0 is author evidence, not an independent execution.

constraints: No product source or repository test edits
No paid inference or external MCP
Temporary reproduction and reports only under ignored .work

semanticCoverage: Project create/add auto path: POSIX absolute-vs-relative preservation, lexical dot/dotdot/repeated slash normalization, literal backslash/space, control/Unicode/JSON-byte rejection, root path create rejection, existing read-only path intent, defaults retry and native permission text retention.

Project owner isolation: Api identity, CSRF, epoch, effective UID and mode/readiness invalidate old defaults and callbacks; old accepted results cannot close or navigate replacement forms; dev runtime without managed identity remains supported; known root identity stays blocked until confirmation.

Root settings and restoration: exact mode/UID validation, server rootAllowed evidence, explicit change confirmation/revision, no automatic privilege switch, warning retained on identity loss, separate draft namespaces and navigation protection.

Shared model directory: provider-qualified identity and aliases, complete legacy fallback, pagination/cursor bounds, account/runtime invalidation, stale-page exclusion, provider catalog discovery/application and explicit capability/effort admission.

findings.title: POSIX literal backslash roots are conflated with distinct nested directories
findings.trigger: Register distinct POSIX directories /srv/alpha\beta and /srv/alpha/beta, with a native project whose only root is /srv/alpha\beta. Open its edit form and enable replacement of directory scope.
findings.impact: sameRoot reports equality because normalizedRoot unconditionally replaces backslashes. The actual form preselects both registered project IDs, and saving sends both IDs to nativeProject/update, unintentionally broadening category metadata. It also falsely labels the other path registered and offers unrelated project categories in the thread association picker. This is a metadata-selection defect, not evidence of filesystem authorization bypass.
evidence: Direct import of the frozen sameRoot returned true for /srv/alpha\beta vs /srv/alpha/beta, while the new POSIX auto path contract treats backslash as a literal filename character.
NativeProjects.tsx:74-77 filters registered projectIds with sameRoot; 285-304 renders those IDs as prechecked boxes; 106-118 submits them unchanged after explicit scope replacement.

.work/v230-round3-web-repro.test.ts actual component reproduction produced checked=[true,true] and nativeProject/update.params.projectIds=[literal,nested], expected=[literal]. Captured request in .work/v230-round3-web-repro-evidence.json.
NativeProjects.tsx:177 uses the same comparator for registration text. ThreadOrganization.tsx:236-238 uses it to admit available project categories.
Current organization.test.tsx:194-195 covers Windows case/slash compatibility and POSIX case sensitivity, but not literal POSIX backslash identity.
findings.recommendation: Keep slash-leading POSIX paths literal. Apply Windows separator and case rules only for explicit Windows drive roots or backslash UNC roots, and cover all comparator callers with regression cases.
